owner_authorization: J21 authorizes preparation only; execution requires a separate explicit Owner instruction.
objective: If separately authorized, re-evaluate exact residuals on three already archived NAFEMS 13H represented complex systems using the J21 process supervisor. This is post-processing of stored arrays only: it does not assemble FEM matrices and does not solve a harmonic response.

criteria_and_limits.memory_limit_semantics: Sampled soft trigger; not an OS-enforced quota.
criteria_and_limits.budget_overrun: INCONCLUSIVE; preserve earlier complete cases and all checkpoints.
criteria_and_limits.statuses: Report historical guard and historical exact status separately from any prospective result. No new result rewrites J14-J20/J19 evidence.

comparison_limits.abaqus: Documentary published reference only; no local Abaqus execution and no pointwise phase reference available.
comparison_limits.navier: Analytical reference with its own plate-theory and boundary-condition assumptions; it is not an oracle for the represented-system residual.
comparison_limits.interpretation: An exact residual PASS applies only to stored binary values in the archived represented system. It does not validate assembly, physical accuracy, spatial error, or the historical guard decision.
comparison_limits.frequency_note: 2.417 Hz was the largest sampled response among the J19 selected points; this does not identify a continuous resonance frequency.

planned_outputs_if_later_authorized: worker JSON with exact squared norms
input, source, contract, and result SHA-256 manifest
separate historical and prospective status table
